summary: Completed phases 2-6 of 26 (explicit scope for this dispatch), each committed separately. Pinned regression baselines, rewrote THEORY_ARCHITECTURE.md as the canonical theory contract, removed the spatial subtheory and dead semantic wrappers, swept cruft (boneyard/examples_refactored/root strays/stale TODOs), and relocated the logos benchmark script. IMPORTANT: a second concurrent agent instance was independently active on this same task's working tree throughout this dispatch and has since progressed into phase 7 (outside this dispatch's scope) -- see blockers.

blockers.description: A second, independent agent instance was actively editing the same working tree concurrently during this dispatch (evidence: unprompted edits to theory_lib/__init__.py, spatial-domain.md mirrors, test_project_generation.py, verify-refactor.sh; running pytest PIDs this agent did not start; one direct same-file edit collision on test_cvc5_stability.py, non-corrupting). It has now progressed into Phase 7, outside this dispatch's phases-2-6 scope. Likely cause: a duplicate implementer dispatch triggered during this agent's ~45-minute background oracle-suite wait. Orchestrator should confirm only one active implementer runs on task 126 before the next dispatch, to avoid a third collision.

The oracle suite baseline run (oracle/bimodal_logic/tests/, 550 tests, part of Phase 2) was still running in the background at handoff time (~48+ min elapsed) and had not written baselines/oracle-run.txt or baselines/junit-oracle.xml to completion. Its dot-stream showed at least one non-xfail 'F' failure marker around the 26% mark that was not yet resolved to a named test at handoff time. A future dispatch should check for a completed run and either commit the results or re-run oracle/bimodal_logic/tests/ -q --junit-xml=... and investigate the F before treating Phase 2 as fully closed.
